description: This PHP source file contains unit tests for the FIFOEntitlementConsumptionStrategy class within the Leave Entitlement module of the OrangeHRM project. It verifies the behavior of leave entitlement consumption logic in various scenarios, including when no entitlements are available, when entitlements are sufficient or insufficient, and when applying changes to leave entitlements. The tests utilize mock objects for dependencies such as data access objects and services, and include setup routines for test fixtures.
